newsitem.title: FRANCE: GOLF-PLAY ABANDONED IN FRENCH OPEN THROUGH RAIN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PLAY ABANDONED IN FRENCH OPEN THROUGH RAIN.

text.p: A third heavy rainstorm forced play on the first day of the French Open to be abandoned on Thursday without any player completing a round.
South African Retief Goosen was six under par after 11 holes, holding a three-stroke lead over the field.

Play was delayed three hours at the start because of heavy overnight rain and then suspended in the afternoon for more than three more hours. Players were just about to start again when another heavy shower brought them in, with the course waterlogged.
